# Sponsor Finder Skill

## When to Use

- Reviewing OSS dependency sustainability
- Building a shortlist of packages/projects for sponsorship

## Workflow

1. Identify top dependencies used by the project.
2. Check whether maintainers/projects have sponsorship channels.
3. Summarize candidates with rationale (criticality, maintenance risk, usage).
4. Propose a lightweight review cadence.

## Notes

This repository currently focuses on LangGraph experiments, so this skill is optional and mostly organizational.
